versions.changelog:
Kingdoc 4.3.5

- Updated compliance and sensitive words packs in the references (base, edu, finance, gov, medical)
- Improved compliance logic in engine modules: compliance_center.py, compliance_check.py, compliance_scheduler.py, compliance_suite.py
- Enhanced API and server logic (engine/api/mcp_server.py)
- Documentation improvements (README.md, SKILL.md)
- Removed legacy documentation file (skill-card.md)

Kingdoc v4.3.0

- 全新合规能力：引入合规性定时调度和合规性套件（engine/compliance_scheduler.py, engine/compliance_suite.py）
- 支持敏感数据包管理，新增多种场景适用的敏感词包配置
- 配置流程优化：首次配置可直接由 AI 引导，无需手动执行安装脚本
- 移除环境与初始化脚本，提升部署简洁性
- 文档更新：完善功能说明、调整首次启动引导，与新版交互保持一致
- 代码结构优化，为合规和配额管理等后续扩展做准备

Kingdoc 4.2.0 introduces major enhancements and internal refactoring.

- Added 10 new modules, including airscript, knowledge_hub, webhook_center, CRDT table, and compliance_center for expanded functionality.
- Significant code cleanup: removed 40 files and restructured OCR, local, and server components.
- Improved OCR and document processing flows with updates to multiple engine files.
- Updated documentation in README and SKILL.md to reflect new capabilities and usage patterns.
- Foundation for future features with modular expansion and webhook/event processing support.

KingDoc 4.0.0 introduces major internal enhancements and expanded engine capabilities.

- Added 41 new Python engine module files, expanding support for blocks, categories, local/remote bridges, OCR, quota management, history, and more.
- Implemented new support for form analytics, page swapping, and advanced content search.
- Multiple engine API components updated, including mcp_server.
- Removed legacy documentation file (skill-card.md).
- README and SKILL documentation revised for updated feature set.

KingDoc v3.9.0 introduces核心能力增强与编辑体验升级：

- 新增块级编辑、本地配额管理、演示页替换，提升结构化编辑和资源管控能力
- 增加“全格式覆盖格式转换”（支持 jpg/png/txt 等），丰富文档处理场景
- 新增引擎模块：blocks.py（块级编辑）、format_converter.py（格式转换）、page_swap.py（演示页处理）、quota_manager.py（配额管理）
- 支持段落级文档编辑，实现更细粒度的内容调整替代整文件替换
- 文档描述及功能矩阵同步补充体现新能力
- 清理遗留文档，移除 skill-card.md

KingDoc v3.8.0 introduces major upgrades including a new document type, enhanced editing, and full-text search.

- 新增“智能画布”文档品类，支持元素级编辑（CRUD）与 Markdown 增量追加
- 引入“全文搜索”能力，支持本地及云端文档内容检索
- 增强功能矩阵，“9 类文档”全面覆盖，描述项与表格同步更新
- 支持“智能画布元素级编辑”“全文搜索”等 16 项独有增强
- 新增相关模块文件（content_search、element_engine、space_tree 等），移除 skill-card.md
- 优化多处文档描述、能力说明与用户操作指南

Major refactor and capability expansion in v3.7.0.

- Refactored codebase: consolidated modules under new engine structure, removed legacy files and directories.
- Added history management (recycle bin, versions, trash) and multiple new OCR tools (education/formula recognition).
- Introduced enhanced document views: base, calendar, Gantt, and Kanban.
- Enforced local-first Tesseract OCR (data never leaves device).
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md/README.md) to clarify full-lifecycle coverage and highlight new unique features.

KingDoc v3.6.0 adds a fully modular engine directory, enabling local deployments and future cloud sync without code duplication.

- New: Added 46+ new engine and kingdoc files for a modular architecture (including APIs, authentication, collaboration, template marketplace, security, rate limiting, update checks, hardware, OCR, and more).
- Change: Core engine logic and AI adapters refactored for modularity and better maintainability.
- Change: Updated key files (README.md, SKILL.md, main APIs) to reflect the new architecture and usage.
- Remove: Deprecated legacy file `skill-card.md`.
- All features remain 1:1 compatible, now with improved extendability and local/cloud separation.

KingDoc 3.5.0 introduces major structural enhancements for collaboration and document intelligence.

- Added new modules: document categorization, document comparison, and real-time collaboration.
- Improved backend processing in mcp_server.py to support new collaboration features.
- Updated documentation to reflect latest features; obsolete skill-card.md removed.
- Lays groundwork for smarter document handling and enhanced team editing workflows.

Kingdoc 3.4.0

- 新增合规检查（compliance_check.py）及用户敏感词、黑名单、白名单机制，提升安全与内容管理能力
- 增加规范文档（references/format_spec.md）和敏感内容参考文件
- mcp_server.py 及核心文档更新以支持合规与用户校验流程
- skill-card.md 移除，说明转移至其它说明文件
- 文档及说明文档完善，适配新安全与合规功能

Kingdoc v3.3.0 introduces collaborative conflict resolution features.

- 新增「协同编辑冲突解决」模块，基于自研 difflib 实现，支持冲突检测、智能合并及可视化 diff，无需外部依赖。
- engine/conflict_resolver.py 文件加入，实现冲突检测与合并逻辑。
- 优化和调整 engine/api/mcp_server.py 以对接新冲突解决功能。
- 文档：README.md、SKILL.md 详细补充了协同编辑冲突相关用法与说明。
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件。

KingDoc v3.2.0 brings local WPS AI abilities with fallback.  
- Added WPS AI toolset (write, analyze, ppt, read, detect_intent) via new `engine/wps_ai/` modules.
- WPS AI runs locally by default; designed for future backend extensibility without API keys.
- Updated documentation to describe local-first WPS AI workflow and supported actions.
- Small internal changes to `engine/api/mcp_server.py`; obsolete file `skill-card.md` removed.

KingDoc v3.0.0 — Major Upgrade

- Introduced deep integration with native online document APIs for enhanced real-time editing and collaboration.
- Added strict "dangerous operation confirmation" with explicit prompts before deletes, overwrites, batch actions, and permission changes.
- Launched local, keyless features: generate DOCX/PPTX, OCR extraction, hardware profiling—all available out-of-the-box, cloud key required only for online actions.
- Hardware auto-detection now recommends and auto-sets concurrency for optimal performance and stability.
- Added automatic fallback to cloud OCR or user guidance if Tesseract is missing (no manual setup required).
- Expanded documentation: added clear natural language usage samples, frequently asked questions, edge-case boundaries, and full workflow cases.
- Improved file type blocking, enhanced audit trails, and enforced security best practices across potentially risky actions.

KingDoc v2.3.0 introduces enhanced document support and upgrades:

- 增加“思维导图(mindmap)”及“流程图(flowchart)”支持，品类从6大类扩充至9大类。
- 支持本地 Tesseract OCR，实现“图片文字识别”，无需第三方API Key。
- 丰富工作流范例，加入流程图、思维导图及 HTML/网页剪藏等工作流。
- 详细标注每一文档品类的“对标腾讯”能力对照及实现方式。
- 文档结构和说明全面升级，突出 KingDoc 独有能力与腾讯文档差异化。
- 新增“安装 Tesseract OCR”引导及更多本地化功能说明。
v2.1.0 — 金山文档 AI 协作助手更新
v2.0.0 — 金山文档 AI 协作助手：6品类全生命周期管理
